title: Collect structured server events without blocking participant flow

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Structured server-event collection tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/diagnostics/test_server_events.py tests/promo/test_server_event_emission.py

evidence_required: FT-009-AC-002 RED: no diagnostics-owned structured server-event table/emitter or production producer wiring exists, so important lifecycle/error events are not retained and sink latency/failure cannot be shown independent of capture, search, Promo or QR; GREEN: the next-linear owner migration, fixed typed catalog, capacity-256 non-waiting emitter, isolated writer session and accepted producer seams persist allowed rows while blocked/full/failed sinks leave every caller transaction, response and participant outcome unchanged without retry; decisive comparison: every catalog code plus held-sink, full-queue and database-failure cases against unchanged owner state/outcome and a forbidden-field inventory; artifact: migration, runtime-isolation and redaction evidence under .tasks/TASK-090-T3-FT-009-W1/.
purpose: Create the smallest diagnostics-owned runtime collection boundary that retains useful fixed server events without placing PostgreSQL latency, failure or protected payloads on participant-critical paths.
success_outcome: Every accepted event code can be persisted as the exact redacted row through an isolated non-waiting writer, while unavailable capacity or storage changes no capture/search/Promo/QR behavior.
anti_goals: Do not ingest browser logs, attach arbitrary messages/payloads, capture the Python root logger or serialize exceptions/request bodies.
Do not add a broker, reliable outbox, delivery retry, internal scheduler, new runtime role, second datastore or shutdown-drain guarantee.
Do not implement the staff search page, FT-008 navigation, 30-day deletion, annotations, Calibration or production configuration.

forbidden_scope: Production PostgreSQL rows, staff/display credentials, participant data and unredacted retained task artifacts
Direct producer writes to diagnostics tables and mutation of Promo/QR/Attempt outcomes for logging
Browser logging, generic logger capture, event broker/outbox, FT-009 staff UI/retention and FT-010/FT-011 behavior
stop_conditions: The fixed envelope cannot exclude arbitrary payloads and every forbidden data class before enqueue.
Blocked/full/failed persistence cannot remain isolated from caller latency, transaction and participant outcome without a broker, reliable queue or new architecture edge.
Producer wiring would require direct diagnostics-table access, a new capability owner or a new module dependency outside the accepted Boundary Map.
T3 runtime/redaction probes cannot use disposable database state, synthetic identifiers, safe rerun and fully redacted artifacts.

constraints: Primary owner and code root are diagnostics at src/face_moment/diagnostics/; promo producers use only the existing application boundary and entrypoints bind lifecycle adapters without selecting or writing events.
Use exactly the fixed catalog, envelope and capacity-256 non-waiting FIFO; producers cannot override severity/component or attach free-form context.
Resolve the actual direct Alembic predecessor after migration 0017 and prove only this revision's upgrade/downgrade, schema transition and data preservation on a disposable database.
Emit only after the corresponding owner state/outcome is known; event failure never rolls back, retries or changes that owner result.
Use a held writer latch rather than an arbitrary millisecond threshold to prove non-blocking completion, and retain only synthetic redacted evidence.
invariants: Diagnostics alone validates and writes server-event rows; one shared database schema does not grant producers direct write authority.
Queue or sink latency, capacity exhaustion, database failure and shutdown may lose an event but never wait, retry or alter capture/search/Promo/QR.
Stored rows contain only the fixed typed fields; credentials, auth state, participant/session data, media, embeddings, bodies, arbitrary payloads and tracebacks never enter the envelope.
Attempt identities are nullable logical references without cross-owner cascade; uncorrelated server events remain valid.
verification_targets: Disposable migration/repository fixtures prove exact table fields, constraints, indexes, fixed catalog, immutable projections, restart persistence and no ownership-crossing foreign-key cascade.
A per-code producer matrix proves fixed severity/component/correlation and complete forbidden-field absence without browser ingestion or arbitrary logger capture.
Held-sink, full-queue and failed-database integrations prove caller completion and unchanged Attempt/result/display/QR state and responses before persistence release, with no retry or owner rollback.
Ownership/import inspection proves diagnostics-only persistence, accepted promo -> diagnostics calls, adapter-only entrypoints and no broker, outbox, scheduler, new runtime role or second store.
